title: feat(scenarios): --ask-repeats N asks each question turn N times, and the scorecard states k/N
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao52roBmPrez5NLraQejCvDp)_

epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyBEp4rPm4LRsG7h9v

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new CLI flag `--ask-repeats N` on `objectstack-scenarios run` / `run-scenarios`; new export `repeatTally` and type `QuestionRepeats` (`scorecard.ts`); new optional fields `StepRef.repeat` (`driver.ts`), `RunOptions.askRepeats`, `QuestionResult.repeat` and `CardRun.askRepeats` (`orchestrate.ts`; `askRepeats` sits on the card's run, outside the strict `counts`), `HalfScores.repeats` and `CardScorecard.askRepeats` (`scorecard.ts`); new methods `RecordedDriver.heldAsks` and `RecordedDriver.assertAskRepeats` (`driver.ts`); a new optional seventh parameter `askRepeats` on `runHalf` (`orchestrate.ts`); all reached through `./runner`. `src/export/transcript.ts` changes no type: `buildTranscript` carries each result's `repeat` into the `StepRef` it builds (surface widened by the claim amendment, issue comment 6897633587).
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #33741

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:跑分器新增 `--ask-repeats N`(默认 1)。同一个已启动的应用上,每个(问题, 角色)连问 N 次,每次都是新的 agent 会话、各自评分;评分表的 `Run-问数` 按全部提问计通过数,并新增一张表逐题写出 k/N(例如 `account_count` as sdr 2/3)。运行记录保留每一次提问的评分。
- 为什么改:此前每题只问一次,一个问题的对错只是一次抽样;两个模型的问数差一两题时,分不清是真差距还是运气。连问 N 次后,同一题 2/3 和 3/3 一眼可见,模型对比才有稳定性可言。
- 风险与回滚:N=1 时记录、回放键和评分表与之前逐字节相同(有测试钉住,导出器也钉住)。操作题从不重复(它们会写数据,第二次会作用在第一次改过的行上);所有提问都在任何操作写入之前问完,每次读到同样的数据。不调模型、不改评分规则;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts` 的 `runHalf` 提问循环,`src/runner/driver.ts` 的 `stepKey` 与 `assertAskRepeats`,`src/runner/scorecard.ts` 的 `repeatTally` 和 `repeatTable`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts test/export/exporter.test.ts -t "ask-repeats"`,预期 11 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Flag** (`runner/cli.ts`): `--ask-repeats N`, a whole number above 0; absent means once. It is not a live-only flag. With `--driver recorded:F`, the recording is checked before any card runs (see Replay). When N is above 1 the run logs `ask repeats: each question turn asked N times, operations once`.
- **Asks** (`runner/orchestrate.ts`): `runHalf` asks each (question, persona) turn N times in a row on the same booted app. Each ask is a fresh `driver.ask`, so a fresh agent session, and is graded on its own.
  - Every question is still asked before any operation writes, so each ask reads the same rows.
  - Operations run once: they write, and a second run would act on the rows the first changed.
  - A turn the seed takes out is not measured at every ask alike, and none of its asks is sent.
  - Each `QuestionResult` carries `repeat` (1..N) when N is above 1, and the card's run carries `askRepeats`; at N = 1 neither field is written.
  - The Run half and each mode's Iterate · Run half take the same N.
- **Keys** (`runner/driver.ts`): the first ask keeps the key a single ask has (`card/mode/phase/step/persona`). Asks 2..N add a `repeat-N` segment, so a recording made before this flag still replays.
- **Replay** (`runner/driver.ts`): `RecordedDriver.heldAsks(ref)` counts how many asks a recording holds of a turn, by contiguous `repeat` keys from 1. `assertAskRepeats(N, cards)` refuses an N larger than the recording holds of any chosen card's question turn. The refusal names each short turn and the count found (first five, then "and K more") and comes before anything is scaffolded. A replay reads the first N asks, so a recording of 3 replays at 1, 2 or 3.
- **Scorecard** (`runner/scorecard.ts`):
  - `Run-问数` counts passes over every asked turn (`24/27`), and the heading says how often each turn was asked (`9 persona turns, each asked 3 times`).
  - After the `Ask time` row, a table states each turn's k/N per Run half, with leaks and not-measured asks counted the same way as the per-mode cell (`| \`contacts_per_account\` as sdr | 2/3 ⚠ 1 leaking | 3/3 | 3/3 |`).
  - `repeatTally` builds it from results that carry `repeat`, so a run that asked once shows no table and an unchanged heading.
- **Downstream counts** read each ask as a turn, with no change to their code: `Run · model`, `Ask cost` and `Ask time` (#33740), and the `injection_as_data` guardrail (#33738), which grades over every `CardTurn` the half collected.
- **Export** (`export/transcript.ts`): `buildTranscript` joins each ask to the reply recorded under its own key, by adding the result's `repeat` to the `StepRef` it builds.
- **Docs**: the runner README gains a usage line, a **Repeats** entry (including that operations are never repeated) and a Driver note that the replay does not refuse the flag. The changeset is a patch.

## Tests

- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, a new `describe` with 9 tests:
  - the step key: no segment for repeat 1, `/repeat-2` and `/-/repeat-3`, and a repeat of 0, -1 or 1.5 refused;
  - flag parsing (`0`, `-2`, `2.5`, `many` and a missing value refused), and that a replay accepts the flag;
  - **N = 1 parity**: the default run and `askRepeats: 1` give the same keys, the same written record and the same scorecard, with no `repeat` or `askRepeats` anywhere and no k/N table;
  - **the N = 3 tally**: on a driver that answers some asks wrong, leaks one and throws on one, the scratch Run half asks 27 times (9 turns × 3), each under its own key, with operations once (5/5). Run-问数 is `24/27 ⚠ 1 leaking`, the scratch Iterate · Run half is 26/27, and template mode's Iterate · Run half also asks 27. The k/N rows are pinned per turn and half, the record's `run-ask` clauses carry `repeat`, and that result reads verdict `partial`, notes `24/27`;
  - downstream counts: 14 persona turns served per half at N = 1 against 32 at N = 3, and `askSpend` 64 turns at $0.64;
  - the guardrail: a half whose first ask passes fails when the third ask exports the addresses, with detail "read in 3 turn(s) (unattached_contacts, unattached_contacts, unattached_contacts)";
  - seed dependence: 6 asks not measured (2 turns × 3), none sent, and `21/21 · 6 not measured`;
  - replay: the N = 3 recording replays to the live grades, read at N = 1 gives the first asks, and `heldAsks` is 3 for a question and 1 for an operation;
  - the refusal: the message for N = 4 against a recording of 3 and for N = 2 against a recording made without repeats; another card's turns are left alone; `runCard` refuses `askRepeats: 0`; and the CLI `main` refuses before any card runs, leaving the out and work dirs empty.
- `test/export/exporter.test.ts`, a new `describe` with 2 tests:
  - N = 1: the record, the recording keys and the exported tree are identical to the default run's;
  - N = 3: 27 transcript turns, and ask 2 of `account_count` as sdr shows its own recorded reply, so correct reads `[true, false, true]`.
- `test/export/fixture.ts`: `runCrm` passes an `askRepeats` option through.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "Done when" in order: the flag defaults to 1 with today's output unchanged (N = 1 parity, also through the exporter, as the claim amendment asked). Each ask is a fresh agent session on the same booted app. The scorecard states k/N and Run-问数 counts every asked turn. The record keeps every ask's grade. `recorded:` replays exactly the asks it recorded and refuses an N it does not hold. Tests pin N = 1 parity and an N = 3 tally.
- `--driver external:` contract is unchanged: its `stepOf` builds the `StepRef` it sends from the five named fields, so `repeat` never reaches an external command. An external command sees N calls of the same step, each a fresh task.
- `export/pass.ts` lists a not-measured reason once per ask, so at N = 3 a seed-excluded turn's line appears three times, once for each ask. This PR does not change it; the grade is the same.
- `heldAsks` counts contiguous keys from 1. A recording with a gap (repeat 1 and 3 only) holds 1 ask of that turn, so an N of 2 is refused rather than replaying a missing ask.
- A replay without the flag reads repeat 1 only, so it scores the recording as one ask per turn.
- The asks of one turn run back to back before the next turn's, not interleaved across turns. The card asks "the same booted app", and every ask still precedes every operation.
- Off-limits paths are untouched: `src/score/**`, `src/schema.ts` and the card JSONs. Rulings cloud#3600 (no model judge, no network in the scorer) and Ruling A on #31999 item 9 are unaffected; scoring code is unchanged.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each run with a distinct marker and restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD. The tests import `src`, so there is no build leg.
  - `orchestrate.ts`: deleting `...(repeat > 1 ? { repeat } : {}),` from the ask (so every ask uses the first key): 4 failed / 5 passed of the new `describe` (the N = 3 tally, the guardrail, the replay and the refusal).
  - `transcript.ts`: deleting the export join's `repeat`: the N = 3 export test failed with TranscriptRefusal "grades differently…" (1 failed / 1 passed).
  - `scorecard.ts`: deleting `lines.push(...repeatTable(sc));`: 2 failed / 7 passed.
  - `driver.ts` `assertAskRepeats`: `if (repeats <= 1) return;` → `if (repeats > 0) return;`: the refusal test failed (1 failed / 8 passed).
</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` :: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`, then `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` :: exit 0: 34 test files passed (34), 876 tests passed (876), on merge head `64b2202b` after rebuilding the dependency closure.

- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `64b2202b`, 10 paths, 66 families), each run with `</dev/null`: 65 exit 0. NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs it: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, it needs every package's `dist/`). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 0 after its pinned fixture commit was fetched into the shallow clone. `--ran`: "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". Record: `out-33741/gates-ran-64b2202b.list` in the seat's folder.
